Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.scoreboard

Interface ScoreboardService

public interface ScoreboardService
Addon contributions to Zentrix's sidebars.

Zentrix renders the configured lobby and per-state sidebars as before, then passes each one to the registered SidebarContributors, highest priority first and equal priorities in registration order, each seeing the previous one's result. Only what actually changed is sent to the player, so a contributor that returns the same text costs no packets.

Without registrations nothing of this runs. Registrations end on their own when the owning plugin disables.

Since:
1.8.0
